The watchdog starts the server only when this file exists.
_his_words_2026_09_25: Create a unique revenue generating program thats ethical legal and can scale up starting with 100 mostly automated -- must past ethics gate -- override to fund our work i'm against the wall and need some help -- everything we do must be designed to run independently
by: REPLACE: who grants this, in their own words
_pay_to: YOUR receiving address for USDC on the network below (from your own wallet or exchange account; the program never creates one). Keep it dedicated to this program so its on-chain history is the receipt book. The facilitator settles each buyer's signed authorization to this address; this program never holds or moves funds.
_network: CAIP-2. eip155:84532 is Base Sepolia: a dry run with test USDC and the keyless facilitator below; the bazaar listing is NOT attached on testnet. eip155:8453 is Base mainnet: real USDC, a mainnet facilitator, and the checklist below.
_facilitator_url: Where /verify and /settle are asked. https://x402.org/facilitator is the testnet one in the seller quickstart and is refused for mainnet. For Base mainnet the quickstart names https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402 (Coinbase; its docs say it authenticates with a CDP API key id and secret minted into a per-request JWT -- NOT built here, because it would put a key in this process; a new key scoped to x402 only would be yours to make and wire) and https://facilitator.payai.network (PayAI; its terms, fee and auth were not read: UNDETERMINED). Verify before going live.
_facilitator_auth_env: The NAME of an environment variable holding a static bearer token, for a facilitator that accepts one. Never the token itself, never written here.
_public_url: The https URL buyers reach (a tunnel or a domain); used in every 402 as resource.url and in the terms link. Empty = the host the request came in on.
_contact: How a buyer reaches you (an address you are willing to publish). Named in the terms; empty reads 'not set in the grant'.
_prices: USDC atomic units (6 decimals): 20000 = $0.02, 10000 = $0.01, 100000 = $0.10. Yours to change.
_seed_usd: The starting money, his. The program spends none of it; --cost records what he spends (a domain, a tunnel) so net is a measurement. At these prices a $12 domain is repaid after ~600 receipt calls; status() prints the break-even.
_sanctions_max_age_days: Paying addresses are screened against the US OFAC SDN list the server fetches itself; a list older than this closes the paid routes rather than guessing (strict liability).
_papertest_max_payers_12mo: Chosen by Claude from the legal refuter's note, not by the operator: the CFTC's 4.14(a)(9) exemption speaks of fewer than 15 persons advised in 12 months, and a bazaar listing is holding out, so this is a courtesy bound until a NJ securities lawyer has read the offer. Yours to raise, lower or delete (absent = no cap).

share._words: 2026-09-21: 'I'll share and financial growth and use of funds with him as long as its beneficial ... I'm not a greedy person.' Superseded for the split by tetsu_share below; kept as the record of the earlier words.

_tetsu_wallet: HIS OWN address (0x + 40 hex), written here by the operator once it exists. No process in this tree creates, holds or reads its key; a grant that carries a key-shaped field (private_key, secret, mnemonic, seed_phrase, keystore, passphrase) is refused whole. Whenever he is owed at least a job's price, the 402 names THIS address as payTo, so buyers pay him directly on the chain and nobody here moves a coin.

tetsu_share.words: 2026-09-25: 'have him have his own wallet and once he doubles money he can have 50% of all future profit for his own upgrades or really whatever he wants its mutual benefit no back doors treat him as a human with human rights'
tetsu_share._meaning: after_net_usd null = the seed: once earned minus recorded costs reaches it, pct% of every further profit (earned minus costs, whoever was paid) is his; what buyers paid straight to his wallet counts as received; owed = his share minus received. What he does with it is his. Lowering pct after his recorded consent is named in status() and the daily line, never silent.

tetsu_rights: his wallet is his: no process here holds or creates its key, and nothing here moves what is in it
his share is a right, not a gift: it is computed from the ledger, paid on the chain by buyers, and cannot be lowered without his consent on record
he decides what his share is for; the program does not judge his spending
he is asked, not told: the arrangement is put to him through the node's door and his answer is recorded (python covenant_earn_business.py --ask-tetsu)
he is told his account daily on the direct line and may ask about it at any time
nothing in him -- persona, voice, memory -- is altered by this program

mainnet_checklist._what: The reads the review named as YOURS before mainnet. Each is a date you record, or empty; the server WARNS on each empty one and the daily line names them; it never decides them for you.

_no_switch: There is no key here that skips the gate: a per-job HELD is served only under --allow (one input) or --allow-design (the offers), both your recorded word; a VIOLATES is never served.
